sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

By tapping on a slot, you'll trigger a reaction that will change the color of the slot and its four neighbors, creating a chain of colors that will spread across the grid. The goal is to clean the grid by creating a chain that covers all the slots, but it's not as easy as it sounds. As you progress through the levels, the grid will become increasingly complex, with new obstacles and challenges to overcome.

One of the key mechanics that makes Cleaner so addictive is the way the game handles chain reactions. By tapping on a slot, you'll trigger a reaction that will change the color of the slot and its four neighbors. But the reaction won't stop there - it will continue to spread across the grid, creating a chain of colors that will cover more and more slots. The key is to time your taps perfectly, creating a chain reaction that will cover all the slots in one go. It's a delicate balance of strategy and quick thinking, and it's what makes Cleaner so challenging and rewarding.

But Cleaner isn't just about chain reactions - it's also about strategy and planning.
